_note: Q (Terrify) has base vs Feared(2x, TotalPercentHealthDamageFeared) tiers -- Feared requires the target ALREADY being feared from a PRIOR source (not guaranteed by this cast itself, since Q is what applies the fear on hit), so the BASE (non-doubled) tier is curated to avoid assuming a precondition the cast doesn't itself satisfy (opposite reasoning from Darius R's self-stacking case). W (Bountiful Harvest / drain) DrainDamageCalc is a per-tick DPS value (TicksPerSecond=4 over up to DrainDuration=2s per channel-hold); curated as ONE tick (Brand P conservative-DoT precedent), not the full channel. R (Crowstorm) similarly has DamagePerSecond ticks over a 5s zone; the BIN's own TotalDamage/APRatioFullDuration calcs multiply by the FULL 5s duration, which would assume the target never leaves the zone -- P2-noncompliant over-assumption, so curated DamageDone (one 0.25s tick, DamagePerSecond*0.25+APRatio) instead, tagged Zone; this deliberately UNDER-represents R's real total damage output (a full channel can deal several times this), so BurstCeiling was intentionally NOT applied despite R being Fiddlesticks' actual biggest realistic burst tool, to avoid the tag misleadingly pointing at a known-conservative undercount. E (Reap) Damage = BaseDamage + 0.5 AP, straightforward. P (Dread) has null DataValues/mSpellCalculations -- no damage.
